description.zh: 如果数据过多，会返回NextToken，用于查询下一页。
description.en: The token used to start the next query. If the amount of data exceeds the limit, this parameter is returned for you to query the next page.

description.zh: 第N个资源Id，此处是为集群Id。可同时查询多个资源，可以传参数名为ResourceId.2、ResourceId.3等等。N为正整数。
description.en: The ID of resource N. In this context, the resource ID is the cluster ID. You can query multiple resources at a time by specifying ResourceId.2, ResourceId.3, and so on. N is a positive integer.

description.zh: 要查询的标签的key，可有多个。N为正整数。
description.en: The key of the tag to query. You can specify multiple keys. N is a positive integer.

description.zh: 要查询的标签的value，可有多个。N为正整数。
description.en: The value of the tag to query. You can specify multiple values. N is a positive integer.

descriptions.zh: ResourceId和Tag两个参数中必须有一个传参，否则报错。
descriptions.en: You must specify at least one of the ResourceId and Tag parameters. Otherwise, an error is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbase list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token NextToken --resource-id bds-bp15e022622f0000 --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbase ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'bds-bp15e022622f0000' --Tag.1.Key key1 --NextToken NextToken --Tag.1.Value value1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
